verdict.rationale: OpenAI's API provides the building blocks for data-driven insights — file search/retrieval tools to bring 'your own data' into model responses (gpt-docs-29), function calling to pull in external data (gpt-docs-7/18/31), and web/file search tools (gpt-docs-19, gpt-docs-4) — but these are developer primitives, not a ready-made in-product 'insights' experience for an end user. Missing for 10: no first-party example of a finished analytics/insights UI, no evidence of automatic proactive suggestions surfaced to a user without custom integration work, and no independent/hands-on account of this specific insights-from-data workflow succeeding in production.
